snippets.title: Find the largest files
snippets.description: List the biggest files below a folder on Windows.
snippets.code:
# List the biggest files below a folder (Windows / PowerShell)
param(
    [string]$Path = "C:\Users",
    [int]$Top = 20
)

Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Sort-Object -Property Length -Descending |
    Select-Object -First $Top FullName,
        @{ Name = "MB"; Expression = { [math]::Round($_.Length / 1MB, 2) } }
